title: Visual events should be heard: SFX density ≥3/min
principle: In top edits, reveals, counters, and transitions carry sound design — the ear confirms what the eye sees. Our provisional floor is 3 SFX per minute for explainer-format videos.
rule: Place an SFX cue on set-piece moments (slams, settles, reveals, transitions); lib/quality-bar.mjs blocks below minSfxPerMinute at the ship gate. The specific number is a ViewForge hypothesis and must earn validation on our own channels.

source.rationale: Observed convention across 1M-view visual-only channels (sound-designed reveals), but no external quantitative source found for the 3/min floor — so it enters as a hypothesis with an expiry rather than a documented claim.
